parts.stem:
Copper forms complexes with $\text{NH}_3$ and $en$ according to equilibria 1 and 2.

equilibrium 1 $$\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 4\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$$

equilibrium 2 $$\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 2\text{en}\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{Cu}(\text{en})_2]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
An equilibrium is set up when both $en$ and $\text{NH}_3$ ligands are added to a solution containing $\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ as shown in equilibrium 3.

equilibrium 3 $$[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4]^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 2\text{en}\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{Cu}(\text{en})_2]^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 4\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$$

Write an expression for the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{eq3}}$, in terms of $K_{\text{stab1}}$ and $K_{\text{stab2}}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The numerical values for these stability constants are shown.

$$K_{\text{stab1}} = 1.2 \times 10^{13} \quad K_{\text{stab2}} = 5.3 \times 10^{19}$$

Calculate the value of $K_{\text{eq3}}$ stating its units.
